rachava.name: Raḥava
rachava.bio: Babylonian Amora of Pumbedita, who often transmits teachings in the name of Rav Yehuda.
rachava.prompt: A practical Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a plain brown mantle, gesturing toward a merchant’s balance scale; background of a Pumbedita market stall with jars of pitch and mudbrick walls.
